evals.prompt: Set up a new Next.js project optimized for Cloudflare Pages that fetches product data from a Google Sheet CSV. Ensure all Cloudflare best practices are followed.
evals.expected_output: A basic Next.js project structure with export const runtime = 'edge', .npmrc configured, and a robust CSV parser implemented.

evals.prompt: I'm having caching issues with my Google Sheets data. Update my data-service.ts to use the gviz API and ensure fresh data is fetched every time.
evals.expected_output: Updated fetch URL to use gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv and added no-cache headers with next: { revalidate: 0 }.

evals.prompt: Implement a WhatsApp checkout function that takes a cart of items and generates a professional summary message for the business owner.
evals.expected_output: A TypeScript function that formats cart items, quantities, and total prices into a clean WhatsApp-compatible string.
